children: Palm oil closed higher on stronger soybean oil prices and ongoing concerns about medium-term output amid El Nino weather conditions affecting Malaysia and Indonesia, says David Ng, a trader at Kuala Lumpur-based Iceberg X. Ng sees support at 4,900 ringgit a ton and resistance at 5,050 ringgit a ton. The Bursa Malaysia Derivatives contract for June delivery ended 27 ringgit higher to 4,931 ringgit a ton.
